title: ui(studio): external-object fields show their datasource and read-only state; no DDL affordances on an external object (epic #27261 P1, D6 first half)
body:
Blocked-by: #27276

Filing gate ③ (maintainer-directed). Ruling 6471382887 on #27261 (batch #423, maintainer 「立专题卡」 2026-10-28): the ontology-over-external-systems epic opens with Tier A (plugin driver, zero protocol change). Part of #27261. Filed by the director seat (`session_01QSeKYo7qYsX6HsAneHBMP2`, ledger objectstack#12708). ⛔ Not a claim; triage sets the lane and grade. Design: #27261 body; the first customer pull: #27130 (route d, design 6468011868).

Ruling-ref: 6471382887

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么：** Studio 对象页：外部绑定对象的字段标出来源数据源与只读；不显示会触发 DDL 的操作（加列 / 改类型）。
- **为什么改：** ADR-0015 欠的 Studio 半边里最小的一块；避免作者在 Studio 里对外部对象做平台会拒绝的事。
- **风险与回滚：** 只读显示；数据源页与 OpenAPI 导入是 P2。
- **先看：** `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/`。
- **两分钟验证：** 一个外部对象在 Studio 里字段带「来自 plan_gantt · 只读」标记，无「添加字段」按钮。
- **需要您做的：** 无。

## Task

- [ ] Read `object.datasource` / `object.external` in the object inspector; render the badge; hide DDL affordances.
- [ ] Unit test.

`Clause-②: no` · `Metadata-protocol: none`. Size S. Lane: ui.

Epic: #27261 (parent; the epic PM dispatches `pm:epic` children). Dedupe: #27261, #27130, ADR-0015; no open card carries this slice.
